Hi Anya / Solano procurement team,

Thanks again for choosing Redwood for the upcoming LLM inference pilot. We're kicking off vendor master setup so we can get purchase orders and first invoices routed cleanly. To complete the vendor record we need the following fields (attachment: vendor_onboarding_template.xlsx):

- Legal business name (as registered)
- DBA (if applicable)
- Tax/EIN number
- Legal entity type and state of formation
- Remit address for checks and ACH details (bank name + last 4 digits accepted)

If you prefer, you can attach a completed onboarding form and your W‑9. We also need to confirm whether your POs should be sent to procurement@solanoaero.com or to a specific PO inbox.

I've looped in our AP intake and procurement mapping folks after your reply. Next step from our side is to create the vendor record in our ERP and send a test PO.
